note: One example = one 180 s Ego4D segment and all its questions. Answers mark evidence phrases with <T1>…</T1> tags; T and Evidence give one or more [start,end] spans in seconds from the segment start (the timeline adds segment_in_video_start to give full-video seconds). 'When did I…' answers are just '<T1></T1>.', so the spans are the answer. Train QA are LLM-generated from narrations; the test set is human-annotated and has a question category. No clip: Ego4D videos (license agreement).
